items.title: Human Tsunami
items.hook: Guess first. Then watch one full crossing.

question.text: How many people do you predict will cross during one cycle?

items.task: Watch one complete crossing. Compare it with your guess. You do not need an exact count.
items.reveal: At busy times, the crossing can handle more than 1,000 pedestrians in a single cycle.
items.visualIdea: Aerial Shibuya only after the prediction
items.notes: Prediction/observation only. Do not tell the family that 1,000 people always cross. Exact counting is not required.

items.title: The Dog Who Kept Coming Back
story: Every day Hachiko met his owner at this station.
One day his owner never came home.
What do you think Hachiko did?
items.reveal: Hachiko kept coming back, for years.

moreInfo.title: How long
moreInfo.text: He continued returning to Shibuya Station for 9 years after his owner died.

items.notes: No exact numbers in the child-facing default text. Duration 9 years stays in moreInfo.
